title: Dry culinary herbs safely
summary: Dry correctly identified clean herbs rapidly enough to prevent mould.
steps: Harvest healthy correctly identified leaves before they are dirty, diseased or heavily damaged.
Follow a tested air-drying or dehydrator method appropriate to the herb and local humidity.
Spread thinly with good airflow and protect from dust, insects and direct contamination.
Continue until the tested endpoint is reached; cool before sealing so condensation does not form.
Store airtight, dark and labelled; discard any batch that develops moisture, mould or abnormal odour.
